text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued August 3, 2019 - Appeal DDRT2020-02

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, that the conditions of the order remain in effect, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Jan and Mike Wood Daly and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before January 29, 2020.
